evaluation_methodology.training_split: 60 engines across all cycles (early-life through terminal cycles)
evaluation_methodology.cross_validation: 5-Fold GroupKFold grouped strictly by engine_id to prevent temporal data leakage
evaluation_methodology.test_evaluation: 20 unseen test engines evaluated strictly on their single last/terminal cycle (rul_true)
evaluation_methodology.cv_vs_test_gap_explanation: Cross-validation RMSE (~9.7-10.1 cycles) evaluates across all operational flight cycles, including extensive early linear degradation periods. In contrast, the test set evaluates only the single final truncated cycle of 20 test engines near end-of-life where degradation slopes are non-linear and truncated abruptly, explaining the expected variance gap (~17.6-17.8 cycles).

notes: Trained on synthetic NASA C-MAPSS style dataset. Accuracy on synthetic data is not representative of real physical aircraft engines.
